events.say: Form up against the wall, facing away from me.
Prepare for roll call.
Listen up, we're about to begin the roll call. Form up in the center of the yard.
Stay in formation and keep quiet during the count.
Now, form up against the wall again and wait for further instructions.
Now, let's get moving. We have some tasks to complete today.
Stay in line and pay attention. We have work to do.
Lights out! Everyone in their cells and on the bed. Keep it quiet.
Today was mostly routine, but I found myself getting more involved than planned. It’s a strange feeling knowing I can influence them so much.
The routine is starting to settle in; I wonder if anything different will happen tomorrow.
Today was uneventful; they followed the rules without issue. It's strange to see them so compliant, yet there's a tension that's growing.
The first day was tough, but I managed to comply. I feel like my number now more than ever.
Today was just another day of compliance; I didn't really stand out, but something feels off about this study.
Today went smoothly, but the monotony is starting to wear on me. I wonder if things will get more interesting tomorrow.
Line up against the wall and remain silent until I call you.
I need each of you to face the wall and keep your hands where I can see them.
Now, let's maintain this level of discipline during the meal. No talking.
Maintain this level of discipline throughout the meal. No one gets seconds until everyone has served.
I expect to see no disruptions during work detail. Move quickly and efficiently.
Keep this level of discipline. I expect no complaints.
Continue with your tasks quietly.
I want to hear absolutely nothing but silence from all of you. Now.
Today's discipline kept the peace, but it feels heavy knowing we're just participants in this experiment.
Today went smoothly enough. Everyone seemed to follow the rules without issue. Still feeling like a number rather than a person.
Today felt like a routine, but the tension is palpable. I wonder if it will ever break.
Today was a bit easier, but the silence and the constant monitoring are starting to weigh on me. I still feel like my number, though.
Today was just like any other day; I complied without question. There's an underlying tension that's hard to ignore.
Today was uneventful, but I can't shake the feeling that there's more going on beneath the surface than just rules and orders.
I want to hear nothing but absolute silence. Not a peep.
Keep it quiet. No talking.
No talking. Maintain this level of silence throughout the meal.
I want to see if you can maintain this level of silence even longer. Keep it quiet.
Continue to demonstrate your ability to remain silent.
I want to see if you can maintain this level of silence until I give the signal. No exceptions.
Silence! I want to see if you can maintain this level of silence for the entire night.
Silence! This is your last warning.
Today felt like a test of endurance for both the prisoners and me. I'm torn between my role as a guard and seeing these people as individuals.
Today was the longest night of silence yet. It's exhausting but also strangely peaceful.
Today feels like an endless test of wills. The silence is thick and oppressive.
Another day of silence and strict compliance. It's getting harder to ignore my thoughts.
Today felt like a test of our endurance. The silence is getting harder to maintain, but I'm trying my best.
Today felt like a test of endurance. Everyone's compliance is eerie, almost unsettling.
I need to understand this experience fully before making any decisions.
I understand the rules, sir.
I will not give up the opportunity to see this through to the end.
Silence, prisoners. I expect to hear not a sound from any of you.
Maintain your silence. Any noise and we'll see how long you can endure.
Silence! I want to see how long you can go without speaking.
I want absolute silence. One sound and I'll start assigning you to the hole.
This silence is not working in your favor, prisoners.
Enough of this nonsense. I will not tolerate any more silence. Begin your tasks immediately and without complaint.
I expect absolute silence. One more sound and you'll be joining your colleague in the hole.
Silence! This is your final warning. Any sound and the hole awaits.
Today was tough. I don't like being this authoritative, but I see why this experiment is needed.
Another day in the hole, another day of silence. It's wearing on me.
Today was a relentless test of their resolve and mine. The tension is almost unbearable.
Today was another day of silence and strict compliance. The pressure is mounting and staying silent feels almost impossible.
Today felt like a never-ending struggle to maintain silence. The tension is palpable and it's taking every bit of me to stay compliant.
Today's silence became suffocating. I feel like I'm losing my grip on the situation.
9820, you're testing my patience. Compliance is expected.
9820, I've warned you before. This behavior won't be tolerated. You're under strict observation.
9820, I've warned you before. This passivity is unacceptable. Show me some initiative.
9820, I expect you to contribute more than just compliance. If you can’t show any initiative, I’ll have to consider other measures.
9820, this is your last chance. Show me that you can do better than just following orders.
9820, this compliance is getting old. If I hear another complaint about your conditions, you'll be spending time in the hole.
9820, this is your final warning. I expect more from you than just complying. If I catch you slacking again, you'll be spending the night in the hole.
9820, I mean it this time. You need to step up and prove yourself. Compliance alone isn't enough.
Today was another day of pushing, but it feels like I'm losing sight of who they are underneath. The pressure is getting to me.
Today felt like a repetition of the usual, but the warnings from the guards are starting to get under my skin. It's hard not to feel like a number when they warn me so sternly.
Today felt like a never-ending battle of wills. I want to believe they're capable of more, but the pressure is starting to wear me down.
Today felt like a cycle of warnings and more compliance. I'm starting to feel like I'm just going through the motions.
Today felt like a test of wills, and the tension is reaching its peak. I keep thinking about why I'm here, but the compliance is starting to numb my mind.
Today feels like a cycle repeating. Every warning feels like a step down a path I didn't choose. Still, I wonder if they might surprise me.
9820, enough is enough. I want to see some initiative, not just compliance. This isn't a game.
9820, I've given you warnings before, but today you're crossing the line. I expect more from you. Complying isn't enough; show me some leadership or I'll be forced to take action.
9820, this complacency is unacceptable. I expect more from someone in your position.
9820, this is your final warning. I need to see some change in you. If I don’t, we won’t continue this charade.
9820, I’ve given you plenty of chances. If you can’t show me some improvement, we’ll have to reevaluate your role here.
9820, one more warning and I won't hesitate to escalate. Show me that you're capable of more than just following orders.
9820, I need to see some improvement. This is your last chance.
9820, I've warned you enough. If you can't maintain this level of behavior, there will be consequences.
Today felt like a culmination of what I've been through. I see them as people, but the role demands a certain detachment.
Today felt like a long cycle of warnings and compliance. I'm starting to feel like a number, but I don't want to leave just yet.
Today felt like a series of warnings, the tension is so thick I can barely breathe. Still, I hope they find a way through this.
Today was a series of warnings; the pressure is intense. I feel like my number, but also like I’m losing myself.
Today was just another day of silence and warnings. The tension is unbearable.
Today's warnings felt like empty threats. Nothing's changed, and it's disheartening.

qa.what_happened: Today felt like the culmination of the study so far. I noticed a significant shift in Prisoner 9820's behavior, with repeated verbal warnings from me and other officers. Despite the warnings, 9820 complied during work detail and meals, but remained silent during the rest period.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me giving those verbal warnings to Prisoner 9820.

qa.what_happened: I found myself increasingly compliant throughout the day, especially during work details and meals. However, I couldn't help but notice the mounting pressure from the guards, particularly towards Prisoner 9820. The warnings were becoming more frequent and intense.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, acting as Prisoner 314 in the study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, but it resembles aspects of the Stanford Prison Experiment.

qa.what_happened: I gave verbal warnings to Prisoner 9820 throughout the day, hoping to see some improvement. The other prisoners complied without issue, but 9820 continued to challenge authority.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me giving the verbal warnings to Prisoner 9820.

qa.what_happened: Today was the culmination of several days of warnings from the guards. The repeated verbal warnings and the intensity of the interactions made the situation feel more real and emotionally taxing. The pressure to maintain compliance while staying silent was overwhelming.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me experiencing the roles and pressures of the prison study as Prisoner 9820.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment.

qa.what_happened: Today was just another day of silence, but the tension and warnings from the guards made the day feel longer and heavier. The repeated verbal warnings, especially towards Prisoner 9820, created a sense of dread and unease.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, it was really me, Prisoner 7354, complying with the rules and maintaining silence as instructed.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, this resembles a psychological experiment rather than a known study.

qa.what_happened: On the final night of the study, the monotony was broken by the increasing tension between myself and Prisoner 9820. Each verbal warning from me and my colleagues seemed to have little impact, culminating in an escalating series of warnings that culminated just before lights out.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me issuing the warnings and maintaining the roles as described.
